mapper.sql: id, account_id, app_id, status, session_epoch, context_version, active_role, station_id, linked_sys_user_id, absolute_expires_at, revoked_at, device_label, created_at, version
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO vi_session (account_id, app_id, status, session_epoch, context_version, active_role, station_id, linked_sys_user_id, absolute_expires_at, device_label) VALUES (#{accountId}, #{appId}, #{status}, #{sessionEpoch}, #{contextVersion}, #{activeRole}, #{stationId}, #{linkedSysUserId}, #{absoluteExpiresAt,typeHandler=com.xinyi.rongli.platform.mybatis.ViUtcInstantTypeHandler}, #{deviceLabel})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM vi_session WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE vi_session SET status = 'REVOKED', revoked_at = #{revokedAt,typeHandler=com.xinyi.rongli.platform.mybatis.ViUtcInstantTypeHandler}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{expectedVersion} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
